platforms.name: Outlier AI
platforms.eligibility: 60+ countries incl. Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, South Africa, US, UK, most of EU
platforms.payout: PayPal / bank transfer · Varies by project
platforms.need: 18+, government ID, PayPal or bank account, laptop/smartphone, fluent English for most projects
platforms.redFlags: Never asks for payment to join. If an Outlier page asks for a fee or crypto, it is an impersonator.

platforms.name: Mindrift
platforms.eligibility: Most countries incl. Nigeria and broader Africa (region-tiered pay)
platforms.need: 18+, smartphone or laptop, domain expertise for higher-paying boards, Payoneer account
platforms.redFlags: Calculate the real hourly rate before accepting a fixed-price task.

platforms.name: DataAnnotation.tech
platforms.eligibility: Primarily US, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand; some African access project-by-project
platforms.need: 18+, PayPal account, unpaid entry assessment (1-3 hrs)
platforms.redFlags: Verify your country at signup before investing assessment time.

platforms.name: Alignerr
platforms.eligibility: Global, including Nigeria and Africa; competitive entry
platforms.need: Domain expertise or strong writing/coding skill, ID verification, laptop
platforms.redFlags: Legitimate. Backed by Labelbox. No upfront fees.

platforms.name: Toloka
platforms.pay: Under $3-20 on the open crowd; invite-only expert track pays more/hr
platforms.eligibility: 100+ countries incl. most of Africa
platforms.need: 18+, smartphone sufficient for many tasks, no experience required
platforms.redFlags: Beginner-friendly and open-access, with the lowest pay on this list. Prefer Mindrift for new work.

platforms.name: Prolific
platforms.eligibility: Confirmed: US, UK, most of EU, Kenya, Nigeria, South Africa, Egypt
platforms.need: 18+, accurate demographic profile, PayPal or bank
platforms.redFlags: Reputable in academic research circles.

platforms.name: Remotasks
platforms.eligibility: Most countries incl. Nigeria, Kenya, Philippines, India
platforms.need: 18+, smartphone/laptop, unpaid training modules before paid work
platforms.redFlags: Legitimate but lower-volume than its 2023-2024 peak.

platforms.name: Appen (Appen Connect / CrowdGen)
platforms.eligibility: 170+ countries
platforms.payout: PayPal / direct deposit · Varies by project
platforms.need: 18+, government ID, resume/profile with language skills
platforms.redFlags: Public company. Never pay to join.

platforms.name: Clickworker
platforms.eligibility: 136 countries
platforms.need: 18+, PayPal, ID for UHRS access, basic computer skills
platforms.redFlags: Established. Low pay is the tradeoff, not legitimacy.

platforms.name: Surge AI
platforms.eligibility: Selective by project; strong presence for Kenyan/African vetted workers
platforms.need: Domain tests, background checks, ongoing performance review
platforms.redFlags: Legitimate and well-funded. Clients include major AI labs.

platforms.name: TELUS Digital AI Community
platforms.eligibility: 100+ countries
platforms.need: 18+, ID verification, language proficiency, reliable internet
platforms.redFlags: Backed by TELUS. Check hours before applying.

platforms.name: OneForma
platforms.pay: 14-20 typical, higher for niche language pairs/hr
platforms.eligibility: Global, strongest for bilingual applicants
platforms.need: 18+, language proficiency, smartphone for some mobile projects
platforms.redFlags: Legitimate TELUS-family vendor.

platforms.name: Mercor
platforms.eligibility: 45+ countries
platforms.need: Professional or technical background; 20-min AI video interview
platforms.redFlags: Legitimate marketplace, not a microtask board.

platforms.name: Micro1
platforms.role: Expert AI training & vetted technical roles
platforms.eligibility: Global, selective via AI interviewer Zara
platforms.need: Subject-matter expertise; pass AI interview
platforms.redFlags: Well-funded and legitimate. Not instant-start.
platforms.work: Expert AI training & vetted technical roles

platforms.name: iMerit
platforms.eligibility: Operates in specific regions (India, US, select global)
platforms.need: Formal application; often full/part-time rather than gig tasks
platforms.redFlags: Expect a hiring process, not instant signup.

platforms.name: Sama
platforms.eligibility: Primarily East Africa (Kenya, Uganda) and select regions
platforms.need: Formal application and interview
platforms.redFlags: Legitimate. Not designed for instant flexible signup.

platforms.name: Welocalize RaterLabs
platforms.eligibility: English-fluent countries, including parts of Africa
platforms.need: 18+, strong English, aptitude test
platforms.redFlags: Long-running search-quality vendor. Legitimate.

platforms.name: CrowdGen
platforms.eligibility: 200+ countries
platforms.need: 18+, no experience required
platforms.redFlags: Beginner entry into the Appen ecosystem.

platforms.name: UHRS (Microsoft)
platforms.eligibility: Wide, but vendor-gated — not a direct signup
platforms.payout: Via the vendor (e.g. PayPal through Clickworker) · Via vendor
platforms.need: English test and vendor qualification (e.g. Clickworker)
platforms.redFlags: Direct-access UHRS offers outside known vendors are a common scam.

platforms.name: Voices.com
platforms.eligibility: Global
platforms.need: Recording setup, voice demo reel, account verification
platforms.redFlags: Legitimate voice marketplace. Needs more setup than microtask sites.
